description: Diatonic harmonic quantiser: it quantises one pitch voltage and builds a four note chord from it, one tone per output

params.text: Enables or disables that chromatic note in the scale the quantiser snaps to, and plays it as the chord root in Performance mode
Picks the chord built on the root, stepping through minor major 7th, diminished 7th, half diminished, minor 7th, dominant 7th, major 7th, augmented major 7th and augmented dominant 7th
Steps through root position and the first, second and third inversions, reordering the notes of the chord
Steps through close, drop 2, drop 3 and open voicings, moving notes of the chord into other octaves
Attenuates and inverts the CV input before it is quantised
Sets the glide time of that chord tone, stepping straight to the new voltage when fully anticlockwise
Shifts the pitch by a quantised offset of the incoming voltage over four octaves, a quantised offset of all four outputs over four octaves, or an unquantised offset over two octaves
Lit, the chord quality comes from the QUALITY knob and its CV input; unlit, it comes from the mode the module is set to
Cycles the TRANSPOSE fader through off, quantised offset, global quantised offset and global fine tune; holding it opens the modal scale menu on the note buttons
Scales the voltage range of that chord tone's output, calibrated at the factory against test equipment

inputs.text: The pitch voltage that is quantised to the enabled notes and becomes the root of the chord, -10V to 10V
Shifts the chord quality, 0-5V summed with the QUALITY knob
Shifts the inversion, 0-5V summed with the INVERSION knob
Shifts the voicing, 0-5V summed with the VOICING knob

outputs.text: The quantised root of the chord, -10V to 10V
The third of the chord, at the interval set by the chord quality
The fifth of the chord, at the interval set by the chord quality
The seventh of the chord, at the interval set by the chord quality
10V at every new chord: a 5ms trigger in Quantiser mode, or a gate held while a note button is held in Performance mode

menu: Module Mode: Quantiser, Performance, Unison tuning — Quantiser takes the root from the CV input, Performance plays it from the note buttons, Unison tuning ties the four outputs to one voltage
Modal Selection: Ionian, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Aeolian, Locrian, Aeolian #7, Locrian #6, Ionian #5, Dorian #4, Phrygian #3, Lydian #2, Altered — sets the mode of the harmony
Global Transition Offset: Clear — returns the global transpose offset to zero, both its coarse and its fine part
